claim: Intelligence Economics ranks the mind by capability-PER-RESOURCE, not parameter count: it computes per-GB / per-token / per-$ / per-watt / per-second ratios for the LERF substrate (model-only vs LERF+small-model), plus three knowledge-DENSITY axes (understanding-per-MB, learning-per-MB, reasoning-per-kJ). The EXACT axes (per-token, per-$, per-GB, understanding-density, learning-density) are computed from REAL ledger/measured data deterministically and offline: prompt tokens are summed by lerf.count_tokens over a real task battery and priced by lerf_benchmark.PRICE_PER_1K (the deterministic token/cost ledger), the LERF store size is a real os.stat of the serialized seed store, the cognitive-object count is a real lerf.stats over an ACTIVE population, and the world-model unit count is a real anima.world_model read. On this deterministic data LERF+small WINS every EXACT axis. The two energy/latency axes (per-watt, per-second) and reasoning-per-kJ are explicitly ESTIMATES (energy modelled, no wattmeter), labelled exact=false, never presented as measured.
owner: scripts/intelligence_per_gb.py (compute() -> {capability, axes{per_gb,per_token,per_dollar,per_watt,per_second}, future_axes{understanding_per_gb,learning_per_gb,reasoning_per_watt}, lerf_wins, hermetic_ok}; axis_per_gb/axis_per_token/axis_per_dollar are EXACT, axis_per_watt/axis_per_second/axis_reasoning_per_watt are ESTIMATE; _measure_store_bytes/_measure_learning/_measure_understanding os.stat real serialized stores on throwaway temp dirs; --selftest proves the ratios + LERF wins >=1 axis + hermeticity), scripts/lerf_benchmark.py (deterministic_table() sums lerf.count_tokens per condition and prices via PRICE_PER_1K — the deterministic ledger reused verbatim, never re-derived; _MODELLED_ACCURACY is the labelled capability proxy when Ollama is down), anima/lerf.py (count_tokens, stats, _path, _load_objects, make_* — the cognitive store the economics measures), anima/world_model.py (build_synthetic_world/causal_links/world_causal_chains — the world-model density numerator). Consumed by scripts/growth_dashboard.py density() (reads future_axes learning_per_gb + understanding_per_gb for the accumulation dashboard).

killer_test.name: economics_is_computed_from_real_ledger_data_deterministically_not_a_constant
killer_test.setup: Hermetic temp store (g0pe._temp_store + lerf/world_model/memory_lirf/reliability/constitution redirected). Call intelligence_per_gb.compute(want_live=False) (the SAME entry the growth dashboard calls) and assert: (A) all five resource axes + three density axes compute a finite positive ratio on both sides; (B) the EXACT axes are flagged exact=true and the ESTIMATE axes exact=false (the honesty contract); (C) the per-token ratio is the proven >=50% prompt-token cut and equals 1000*capability/tokens recomputed off the benchmark's OWN deterministic token table (lerf_benchmark.deterministic_table) — i.e. computed from the real ledger, not hardcoded; the per-GB store_bytes equals a fresh real os.stat of the serialized LERF seed store (not a constant); the learning-density object count equals lerf.stats over the seeded ACTIVE population; (D) LERF+small WINS every EXACT axis (per_token, per_dollar, per_gb); (E) NOT-A-CONSTANT: re-serializing a STRICT SUBSET of the seed skills yields a SMALLER measured store than the full population, so the per-GB measurement tracks real store content; (F) DETERMINISTIC: two compute() runs give byte-identical EXACT ratios + densities; (G) the live consumer growth_dashboard.density() returns the SAME learning/understanding densities from the same future_axes. Read-only: report.hermetic_ok is True and the real .anima fingerprint is byte-identical before/after. scripts/certify_intelligence_economics.py is the executable form; scripts/intelligence_per_gb.py --selftest is the in-module form (33 assertions).
killer_test.prompt: what is the intelligence per gb / per token / per watt of the substrate?

known_gaps: NO live user-facing surface: there is no server endpoint and no web/index.html widget for intelligence economics. It is a developer/founder CLI tool (python3 scripts/intelligence_per_gb.py [--json|--selftest]) and is consumed programmatically by scripts/growth_dashboard.py density() (also CLI). So this certifies a REAL + deterministic + hermetic BACKEND/CLI economics computation, not an end-to-end button->endpoint->render live path. That is why it is PARTIAL, not COMPLETE.

ENERGY/LATENCY axes are ESTIMATES, by design and explicitly labelled exact=false: per-watt and per-second (and reasoning-per-kJ) model joules from (model-size -> power) x (tokens -> time) with no wattmeter in the loop; they are a lens, never the verdict. The EXACT axes (per-token/per-$/per-GB + the two density axes) are the deterministic verdict and are what this cert proves.

CAPABILITY is a transparent proxy, sourced='modelled' here: the per-condition task accuracy comes from lerf_benchmark._MODELLED_ACCURACY (B vs E). The LIVE measured accuracy requires Ollama (--live), which is out of scope for a hermetic cert; the proxy is in [0,1] and labelled, and the per-resource WIN is what the thesis turns on, not the raw capability number.
